findings.description: Transient extraction failures permanently mark sessions as processed, preventing future retry. Returns patternsCreated=0 on failure which triggers markSessionProcessed.
Angel messages marked delivered before token budget gating. If extraContent is dropped for budget, messages are permanently lost.
ORDER BY MAX(o.timestamp_epoch) without GROUP BY is invalid SQL. Silently returns empty array, disabling cross-session awareness.
Idempotence guard compares against -0.05 but scores are clamped to >= 0.1, so guard is always true and penalties keep applying.
Trigger-engine matches merged into injected_pattern_ids, but those patterns were never actually injected into context. Feedback scoring rewards/penalizes unshown patterns.
Supersede older-than guard compares to wall clock instead of new artifact timestamp, not enforcing intended relative ordering.
Contradiction detection regex: should matches inside should not, marking two negative statements as contradictory.
DEFAULT_CONFIG missing required ClaudexConfig fields. deepMerge strips keys not present in defaults, making parts of config unconfigurable.
Migration success inferred from no thrown exceptions, but steps are non-throwing. Can advance user_version after partial failure.
Double-embedding: createPattern already fire-and-forget embeds, then Angel also await embeds the same pattern.
embedArtifact/embedPattern return true without checking Qdrant upsert or SQLite UPDATE success. False success reporting.
exitCode compared numerically without normalization. String '0' treated as non-zero failure.
External discoveries stored as external:discovery but promotion queries filter obs_type = discovery, excluding them.
Trigger-data cache keyed by DB handle only, not project. Cross-project cache pollution.
Singleton embedding provider ignores config after first initialization.
Heavy as unknown as casting in config merge/validation bypasses strict typing and hides schema drift.
Spread activation comments claim reverse-link traversal but only queries source_id direction.
searchVectorChannel exported but never called. Dead code at birth.
IngestResult.skipped documented but never incremented.
Docs say EMA update but implementation is additive clamp. Contract/behavior mismatch.
Duplicate learnings upsert uses current agent_id instead of matched row agent_id, can create parallel duplicates.
Topic shift event recorded with ctx.project instead of routedProject, inconsistent with surrounding routing.
Config clone fallback retries same failing deepClone call.
isPathBoundaryMatch only checks first indexOf hit, can miss later valid boundary matches.
